label: About
title: About Paint Gives Way to Air
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1254 recent saved-signal files and 832 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around Living Sculpture | The Art Institute of Chicago and Interlock | The Art Institute of Chicago, plus 4 more. A source image from artic.edu helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Paint Gives Way to Air: Landscape suspended assemblage: a painted shoulder shell and crushed bundles surround a dark hollow; a large unraveling cable loop hangs below. Bare pleats descend past a woven cuff, wooden splice and chalk-lined mirror lip. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Green-and-rust corrugated rim around the upper hollow, Dense twisted cable along the hanging loop's right flank, and Black-and-cream curved woven cuff.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
